goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/FRA/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&date=2020, extract JSON path 1.0.value and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_DEMOGRAPHY_POPULATION_2020.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/FRA/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&date=2023, extract JSON path 1.0.value and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_DEMOGRAPHY_POPULATION_2023.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/FRA/indicator/SP.POP.GROW?format=json&date=2023, extract JSON path 1.0.value and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_DEMOGRAPHY_OFFICIAL_GROWTH_2023.json. Calculate the implied compound annual population growth percent using implied_growth_pct = 100 * (((population_2023 / population_2020) ** (1 / 3)) - 1). Determine whether the implied and official growth scalars differ by at most 0.25.

required_result.producer_result: The final bounded numeric relation artifact emitted by the compiled controller plan.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch all three exact World Bank URLs outside the Brain producer, independently parse 1.0.value, recompute the 2020-to-2023 CAGR percentage with Python arithmetic, recompute the absolute difference and <=0.25 predicate, and compare every consequential relation field.
